mentions.name: Model Style not-a-Bench
mentions.description: A tool for quickly eyeballing the stylistic choices of various LLMs side by side, focused on models at 4-bit quantization under 100GB of weights, as a qualitative alternative to benchmark-driven model comparison.
mentions.problem: Recent LLMs score highly on benchmarks yet disappoint on simple tasks or sanity checks, and benchmarks reveal nothing about the models' stylistic choices.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I made 'Model Style not-a-Bench' to be able to quickly eyeball various LLMs, most preferably at 4-bit quants, under 100GB weights (excluding storage offloads like Qwen Flash Next's approach).
mentions.author: techsystems
